verdict.rationale: Brex is a corporate card platform (global corporate cards) whose Team API manages users, departments and cards. That supports issuing cards to employees, and a community report confirms Brex mails physical cards. However, the evidence never documents finance leads issuing physical cards to individual employees, a debit option, or role-based assignment. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of physical card issuance per employee, debit vs credit card options, defined user roles/permissions tied to card issuance, independent hands-on corroboration.
